claims: Cameron and Cayden Boozer are fraternal twins.
Cameron and Cayden Boozer are the sons of Carlos Boozer and CeCe Boozer.
Carlos Boozer is a former NBA All-Star.
Cameron and Cayden Boozer were born on July 18, 2007.
Cameron and Cayden Boozer committed to play for the Duke Blue Devils.
Cameron and Cayden Boozer were born via in vitro fertilization (IVF).
Cameron and Cayden Boozer were born to be a genetic match for their older brother Carmani.
Carmani was diagnosed with sickle cell disease.
The stem cells of Cameron and Cayden Boozer were used to save Carmani's life.
Cameron and Cayden Boozer have an older brother named Carmani.
Cameron and Cayden Boozer have a younger sister named Bloom.
As of March 2026, Cameron and Cayden Boozer are playing as freshmen for Duke.
